column2: Thorin, a 71-year-old village elder. Weathered, deeply lined face, long unkempt grey-white beard and thinning grey hair, heavy brows over tired haunted eyes, an old faded scar across one cheek. Worn brown wool hooded cloak with the hood down over a patched dark green tunic, a small tarnished brass expedition badge pinned at the collar. Grim and melancholic.

the village blacksmith, a burly broad-shouldered man of about 50, bald head with a thick short dark-brown beard streaked with grey, soot smudges on his face and forearms, strong jaw, focused narrowed eyes. Heavy scorched leather apron over a bare-armed dark shirt, thick leather gloves; faint orange forge glow lighting his face from below.

shown only as a SILHOUETTE cut-out in exactly the same treatment as a placeholder portrait in a pixel-art RPG: the figure filled with a flat dark slate grey-blue (#2a3348) slightly lighter than the background, with NO facial features at all — no eyes, no mouth, no face details — subtle two-tone pixel shading (slightly lighter on the left), a few darker interior lines only for clothing folds and gear edges, a thin warm rim light on the left edge and a thin cool blue rim light on the right edge. Clean, instantly readable outline. Neutral, not scary. Subject: a town gate guard, head and shoulders: a wide-brimmed kettle helmet, a padded gambeson collar, a spear shaft rising past one shoulder.

a town gate guard, a weathered man of about 35 with a short dark stubble beard and alert narrowed eyes, wearing a wide-brimmed steel kettle helmet, a quilted brown gambeson with a blue town tabard, a spear shaft rising past one shoulder. Dutiful, slightly bored expression.

a wandering mercenary priestess of about 28, a gentle but resolute woman with calm warm eyes and a soft smile, long auburn-chestnut hair with a center part falling over her shoulders and a single braid, a thin GOLD circlet with a small gem on her forehead. She wears a long ivory-white robe with a short saffron-ORANGE shoulder mantle trimmed in gold and an orange stole hanging down the front, a string of GOLD prayer beads around her neck. She holds a wooden staff topped with a gold ring that cradles a softly glowing warm golden orb near her shoulder. Kind, serene, determined expression. Modest clothing.
